info.name: ScholarShare API
info.description:
All ScholarShare backend endpoints.

1. Start MySQL + the backend (http://localhost:8080/api).
2. Import this collection and the 'ScholarShare Local' environment, select the environment.
3. Run folder 1 (Auth) top to bottom: it registers a new student, signs in as the admin, approves the student and stores both tokens.
4. Every other folder uses {{adminToken}} / {{studentToken}} automatically.

Every response is { success, message, data }. Tests under each request check the status code.

exec: // A fresh e-mail for the student this run registers.

item.name: Register student -> 201 (active at once, saves studentToken)

request.description: Creates a student. No admin approval: the answer already holds a token, like a login.

item.name: Google sign-in with a bad token -> 401/503

request.description: A real Google ID token can only come from the browser (Continue with Google). This only checks that bad tokens are refused. 503 = GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID is not set on the server.
